description_en: Query the trail configuration attributes of the corresponding AK configuration
description_zh: 查询第三方云资产审计日志接入配置
name: DescribeCloudVendorTrialConfig

parameters.help_en:
Unique ID of the AK.

You can call [DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList](~~DescribeCloudVendorAccountAKList~~) to get the AuthId.
-
parameters.name: auth_id

parameters.help_en:
Cloud asset vendor. Values:
Tencent: Tencent Cloud
AWS: Amazon Web Services
parameters.help_zh:
云资产厂商。取值：
Tencent：腾讯云
AWS：亚马逊
parameters.name: vendor

schema.description_en: The structure of the returned message

AuthInfo.description_en:
Multi-cloud configuration information:
AWS: Output parameters sqsQueueName, sqsRegion
Tencent: Output parameters kafkaUserName, kafkaBootstrapServers, kafkaTopic
AuthInfo.description_zh:
多云配置信息：
AWS：出参 sqsQueueName、sqsRegion
Tencent：出参 kafkaUserName、kafkaBootstrapServers、kafkaTopic

Message.description_en: Error message returned when connection fails
Message.description_zh: 接入错误时返回的错误提示消息

Status.description_en:
The access status of the Trail configuration. Values:
init: Initialization in progress
verify: Configuration verification in progress
enable: Configuration enabled
disable: Configuration disabled
error: Configuration access error
timeout: Configuration access timeout
Status.description_zh:
Trail配置的接入状态。取值：
init：初始化接入
verify：配置验证中
enable：配置生效
disable：配置失效
error：配置接入错误
timeout：配置接入超时

RequestId.description_en: The ID of this request, which is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for this request and can be used for troubleshooting and problem localization
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
